english_title: 28. His Supplication in Fleeing to God for Protection

phrases.english: 1.I showed sincerity by cutting myself off from everything but You.
2.I approached You with my whole self.

phrases.arabic: وَصَـرَفْتُ وَجْهِي عَمَّنْ يَحْتَاجُ إلَى رِفْدِكَ،
phrases.english: 3.I averted my face from everyone who needs Your support.

phrases.arabic: وَقَلَبْتُ مَسْأَلَتِي عَمَّنْ لَمْ يَسْتَغْنِ عَنْ فَضْلِكَ،
phrases.english: 4.I ceased to ask from any who cannot do without Your bounty.

phrases.arabic: وَرَأَيْتُ أَنَّ طَلَبَ الْمُحْتَاجِ إلَى الْمُحْتَاجِ
phrases.english: 5.I saw that the needy who seeks from the needy

phrases.arabic: سَفَهٌ مِنْ رَأيِهِ وَضَلَّةٌ مِنْ عَقْلِهِ،
phrases.english: 6.is foolish in his opinion, and misguided in his intellect.
7.How many people have I seen, my God,

phrases.arabic: مِنْ أُناس طَلَبُوا الْعِزَّ بِغَيْرِكَ فَذَلُّوا،
phrases.english: 8.who sought exaltation through other than You and were abased,
9.who wanted wealth from someone else and became poor,
10.who tried to rise high and fell down low!
11.Observing the likes of them corrects a prudent man;
12.his taking heed gives him success;
13.his choosing the best guides him to the path of right.
14.So Thou, my Master,
15.art the object of my asking to the exclusion of all those who are asked

phrases.arabic: وَدُونَ كُلِّ مَطْلُوب إلَيْهِ وَلِيُّ حَاجَتِي.
phrases.english: 16.and the patron of my need to the exclusion of all those from whom requests are made.
17.You art singled out for my call before all who are called;
18.none is associated with You in my hope,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يَتَّفِقُ أَحَدٌ مَعَكَ فِي دُعَائِي،
phrases.english: 19.none comes along with You in my supplication,
20.nor does any join with You within it, for to You is my appeal.
21.To You, my God, belongs the Unity of number,
22.the property of eternal power,
23.the excellence of force and strength,
24.the degree of sublimity and elevation.
25.Everyone other than You is the object of compassion in his lifetime,

phrases.arabic: مَغْلُوبٌ عَلَى أَمْرِهِ، مَقْهُورٌ عَلَى شَأنِهِ،
phrases.english: 26.overcome in his affair, overwhelmed in his situation,
27.diverse in states, constantly changing in attributes.
28.So You art high exalted above likenesses and opposites,
29.proudly magnified beyond similitudes and rivals!
30.Glory be to You! There is no God but Thou.
